description: Long-term tent history from Amazon Athena (grow_room_telemetry.readings, workgroup grow-room-telemetry, us-west-2). Default range is 30 days. Auto-refresh is off: each panel is its own query, and a full load is six partition-pruned scans. At the volume ship_readings.py writes, each scan is on the order of 10-20 MB over 30 days, well under a cent at $5 per TB. The workgroup cancels a query that would scan more than 1 GiB (about half a cent). Stage is optional and uses the GROW_STAGE bands: seedling 0.4 to 0.8 kPa, veg 0.8 to 1.2, flower 1.2 to 1.5, late_flower 1.4 to 1.6. Null, blank, and any other value use the veg band.

panels.title: Daily VPD (avg / min / max)
panels.description: vpd_kpa per day. Filters the partition column dt with the dashboard time range (UTC) so Athena reads only those days.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  cast(dt AS timestamp) AS time,
  round(avg(vpd_kpa), 3) AS avg_vpd,
  round(min(vpd_kpa), 3) AS min_vpd,
  round(max(vpd_kpa), 3) AS max_vpd
FROM grow_room_telemetry.readings
WHERE dt >= '${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
  AND dt <= '${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
GROUP BY dt
ORDER BY dt

panels.title: Daily temperature (avg / min / max)
panels.description: temperature_c per day, in Celsius. Filters the partition column dt with the dashboard time range (UTC) so Athena reads only those days.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  cast(dt AS timestamp) AS time,
  round(avg(temperature_c), 2) AS avg_temp_c,
  round(min(temperature_c), 2) AS min_temp_c,
  round(max(temperature_c), 2) AS max_temp_c
FROM grow_room_telemetry.readings
WHERE dt >= '${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
  AND dt <= '${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
GROUP BY dt
ORDER BY dt

panels.title: Daily relative humidity (avg / min / max)
panels.description: humidity_percent per day. Filters the partition column dt with the dashboard time range (UTC) so Athena reads only those days.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  cast(dt AS timestamp) AS time,
  round(avg(humidity_percent), 1) AS avg_rh,
  round(min(humidity_percent), 1) AS min_rh,
  round(max(humidity_percent), 1) AS max_rh
FROM grow_room_telemetry.readings
WHERE dt >= '${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
  AND dt <= '${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
GROUP BY dt
ORDER BY dt

panels.title: Percent of readings in the target band
panels.description: Percent of the day's rows whose vpd_kpa falls in the growth-stage band. seedling is 0.4 to 0.8 kPa, veg is 0.8 to 1.2, flower is 1.2 to 1.5, and late_flower is 1.4 to 1.6. A null stage, a blank stage, and any other value use the veg band. Filters the partition column dt with the dashboard time range (UTC) so Athena reads only those days.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  cast(dt AS timestamp) AS time,
  round(
    100.0 * count_if(
      vpd_kpa BETWEEN
        CASE
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('seedling', 'clone', 'clones', 'seedling_clone') THEN 0.4
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('flower', 'flowering') THEN 1.2
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('late_flower', 'lateflower') THEN 1.4
          ELSE 0.8
        END
        AND
        CASE
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('seedling', 'clone', 'clones', 'seedling_clone') THEN 0.8
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('flower', 'flowering') THEN 1.5
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('late_flower', 'lateflower') THEN 1.6
          ELSE 1.2
        END
    ) / count(*),
    1
  ) AS pct_in_band
FROM grow_room_telemetry.readings
WHERE dt >= '${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
  AND dt <= '${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
GROUP BY dt
ORDER BY dt

panels.title: Readings by source
panels.description: Row count per day and source. A null or blank source is counted as unknown. Filters the partition column dt with the dashboard time range (UTC) so Athena reads only those days.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  cast(dt AS timestamp) AS time,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(source), ''), 'unknown') AS source,
  count(*) AS samples
FROM grow_room_telemetry.readings
WHERE dt >= '${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
  AND dt <= '${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
GROUP BY dt, coalesce(nullif(trim(source), ''), 'unknown')
ORDER BY dt, source

panels.title: Daily climate
panels.description: One row per dt in the selected range, with the same stage band as the percent panel. Filters the partition column dt with the dashboard time range (UTC) so Athena reads only those days.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  dt,
  count(*) AS samples,
  round(avg(vpd_kpa), 3) AS avg_vpd,
  round(min(vpd_kpa), 3) AS min_vpd,
  round(max(vpd_kpa), 3) AS max_vpd,
  round(avg(temperature_c), 2) AS avg_temp_c,
  round(min(temperature_c), 2) AS min_temp_c,
  round(max(temperature_c), 2) AS max_temp_c,
  round(avg(humidity_percent), 1) AS avg_rh,
  round(min(humidity_percent), 1) AS min_rh,
  round(max(humidity_percent), 1) AS max_rh,
  round(
    100.0 * count_if(
      vpd_kpa BETWEEN
        CASE
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('seedling', 'clone', 'clones', 'seedling_clone') THEN 0.4
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('flower', 'flowering') THEN 1.2
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('late_flower', 'lateflower') THEN 1.4
          ELSE 0.8
        END
        AND
        CASE
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('seedling', 'clone', 'clones', 'seedling_clone') THEN 0.8
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('flower', 'flowering') THEN 1.5
          WHEN replace(lower(trim(coalesce(stage, ''))), ' ', '_') IN ('late_flower', 'lateflower') THEN 1.6
          ELSE 1.2
        END
    ) / count(*),
    1
  ) AS pct_in_band
FROM grow_room_telemetry.readings
WHERE dt >= '${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
  AND dt <= '${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'
GROUP BY dt
ORDER BY dt
